Profile likelihood of the maximum growth rate and its timing

Source: R/maxrate.R
profile.maxrateTMB.Rd

Profiles the negative log-likelihood over the time of the maximum growth rate (by b2) or the maximum growth rate (by b1) of a curve, re-optimising the other coefficients.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'maxrateTMB'
profile(
  fitted,
  parm = NULL,
  level = 0.99,
  maxit = 100,
  progress = interactive(),
  ...
)

Arguments

fitted

A maxrateTMB object, the result of maxrate.

parm

Character or integer vector, or NULL. Estimates to profile, names or positions in coef(fitted); tmax and rate only. Default all of these.

level

Numeric between 0 and 1. The highest confidence level the profiles are computed for.

maxit

Integer. Maximum number of steps in each direction

progress

Logical. Show a progress bar over the profiled estimates

...

Not used.

Value

a profile.maxrateTMB object, which has the confint and plot methods of profile.gcTMB

Examples

fit <- gcTMB(height ~ DAS, data=FabaHeights25)
pr <- profile(maxrate(fit), parm="rate")
confint(pr)
#>         2.5 %   97.5 %
#> rate 2.380395 2.752209
